extensionAttribute.description: Reports the macOS Content Caching data path.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Content Caching Service Data Path Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # macOS Server (Server.app) was discontinued in 2022; the Content Caching # service is now built into base macOS and controlled via the Sharing # preference pane / AssetCacheManagerUtil. The legacy serveradmin command # no longer exists on modern macOS.
path=$(/usr/bin/defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.AssetCache CacheDataPath 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -z "$path" ]]; then path=$(/usr/bin/AssetCacheManagerUtil settings 2>/dev/null \ | /usr/bin/awk -F': ' '/CacheDataPath/ { print $2; exit }') fi
echo "<result>${path:-/Library/Application Support/Apple/AssetCache/Data}</result>"
